Us ne munh basoor liya aur peeth pher li
Ke un ke paas ek naabeena aa gaya
Aur tumhein kya maaloom shaayad woh paakeeza nafs ho jaata
Ya naseehat haasil kar leta to woh naseehat us ke kaam aa jaati
Lekin jo mustaghni ban baitha hai
Aap us ki fikr mein lage hue hain
Haalaanke aap par koi zimmedaari nahin hai agar woh paakeeza na bhi bane
Lekin jo aap ke paas daud kar aaya hai
Aur woh khauf-e-Khuda bhi rakhta hai
Aap us se be-rukhi karte hain
Dekhiye yeh Quran ek naseehat hai
Jis ka jee chaahe qubool kar le
Yeh ba-izzat saheefon mein hai
Jo buland o baala aur paakeeza hai
Aise likhne waalon ke haathon mein hain
Jo mohtaram aur nek kirdaar hain
Insaan is baat se maara gaya ke kis qadar naashukra ho gaya hai
Aakhir use kis cheez se paida kiya hai
Use nutfe se paida kiya hai phir us ka andaaza muqarrar kiya hai
Phir us ke liye raaste ko aasaan kiya hai
Phir use maut de kar dafna diya
Phir jab chaaha dobaara zinda kar ke utha liya
Hargiz nahin, us ne hukm-e-Khuda ko bilkul poora nahin kiya hai
Zara insaan apne khaane ki taraf to nigaah kare
Beshak hum ne paani barsaaya hai
Phir hum ne zameen ko shigaafta kiya hai
Phir hum ne us mein se daane paida kiye hain
Aur angoor aur tarkaariyaan
Aur zaitoon aur khajoor
Aur ghane ghane baagh
Aur meve aur chaara
Yeh sab tumhaare aur tumhaare jaanwaron ke liye sarmaaya-e-hayaat hai
Phir jab kaan ke parde phaadne waali qiyaamat aa jaaegi
Jis din insaan apne bhai se faraar karega
Aur maa baap se bhi
Aur biwi aur aulaad se bhi
Us din har aadmi ki ek khaas fikr hogi jo us ke liye kaafi hogi
Us din kuch chehre raushan honge
Muskuraate hue khile hue
Aur kuch chehre ghubaar-aalood honge
Un par zillat chhaayi hui hogi
Yahi log haqeeqatan kaafir aur faajir honge
